Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tairakurien-sobauchi/

You'll experience almost the entire soba-making process—from preparing the dough to kneading, stretching, and cutting it. Then you'll eat the "28% buckwheat noodles" (niwachi soba) you made yourself for lunch, served with tempura made from local vegetables.

【Fee】
Adults: ¥4,000 | Elementary school children: ¥3,000 | Preschool children: ¥1,500
(Includes guide, insurance, and lunch)

【Capacity】2 groups (up to 4 people per group)

【Guide】Taira Kuri-en staff

【What to bring】Drinks, apron, headscarf, towel, face mask

【More information】Taira Kuri-en website: https://tairakurien.com/
location: 集合 たいら栗園（西武池袋線「東吾野駅」下車徒歩15分）
summary: Experience soba-making in the countryside — try your hand at making 28% buckwheat noodles!
